claim: On Windows the pinned assembler and zx0 packer may be missing; check they exist before trusting selftest, since .nxc test failures without zx0 are environmental.

evidence.text: Pinned sjasmplus ships only for Linux; a local 1.24.0 reproduced hook bytes; zx0 binary matched the pin; without zx0, 17 of 20 selftest --tools failures were .nxc tests.
